services.subtitle: From school to the airport, from the office to the clinic — MoovAfrik covers all your mobility needs in Libreville.

why.h2: Reliable transport is possible in Libreville.
why.p1: Libreville's transport market still operates largely informally: negotiated fares, approximate schedules, no traceability. For a parent, an HR manager or an event organizer, that's a constant risk.
why.p2: MoovAfrik was built to eliminate that risk. Identified vehicles, trained and rated drivers, systematic WhatsApp confirmation, prices disclosed before booking. No bad surprises. Just a service that works.

services.hubSubtitle: From school to the airport, from the office to the clinic — MoovAfrik covers all your mobility needs in Libreville.

transport-scolaire.name: School Transport
transport-scolaire.cardTagline: Your child boards. You know where they are.
transport-scolaire.h1Line2: You know exactly how they get there.
transport-scolaire.p1: Informal school transport in Libreville means a shared taxi with no fixed route, no guaranteed schedule, and no way of knowing if your child arrived safely.
transport-scolaire.p2: MoovAfrik organizes fixed routes with the same trained drivers every morning, on mapped and validated itineraries. You receive a WhatsApp confirmation as soon as your child boards the vehicle.
transport-scolaire.step1: Contact us on WhatsApp with your child's name, address and school.
transport-scolaire.step2: We suggest the nearest route and the all-inclusive monthly rate.
transport-scolaire.step3: The service starts the following week. Same vehicle, same driver, same time.
transport-scolaire.pricing: 25,000 – 45,000 FCFA / student / month depending on distance
transport-scolaire.pricingDetails: Monthly payment · No registration fee · Suspension possible during school holidays
transport-scolaire.metaDesc: Reliable school runs in Libreville. Same driver, same time, WhatsApp confirmation. from 25,000 FCFA/student/month.

corporate.name: Corporate Mobility
corporate.cardTagline: Your teams arrive on time. Every morning.
corporate.h1: Your teams are at their desks on time.
corporate.p1: Transport-related delays cost energy, productivity and credibility.
corporate.p2: MoovAfrik handles commuter shuttles for your employees with a framework contract, a single monthly invoice and a punctuality report. You run a business. Not a taxi fleet.
corporate.step1: Send us your employee list, their addresses and their schedules.
corporate.step2: We map optimal routes and submit a framework contract within 48 hours.
corporate.step3: The service starts. Single monthly invoice — purchase order accepted.
corporate.pricing: 15,000 – 35,000 FCFA / employee / month depending on zones and volume
corporate.pricingDetails: Framework contract · Monthly billing · Punctuality report included · Minimum 5 employees/route
corporate.metaDesc: Commuter shuttles for your employees in Libreville. Framework contract, punctuality report, single invoice.

aeroport.name: Airport Transfers
aeroport.cardTagline: Flight delayed? The driver waits. You don't pay for the wait.
aeroport.h1Line2: Your driver waits too. You don't pay for the wait.
aeroport.p1: Arriving in Libreville at 2am without a confirmed transfer is unnecessary stress.
aeroport.p2: MoovAfrik monitors your flight in real time. If the plane is 45 minutes late, the driver leaves 45 minutes later. Name board at arrival, luggage assistance, air-conditioned vehicle.
aeroport.step1: Book on WhatsApp with your flight number, arrival time and number of passengers.
aeroport.step2: You receive confirmation within 1 hour + the driver's name and contact.
aeroport.step3: The driver adjusts departure to your actual flight. Name board welcome, transfer, payment.
aeroport.pricingDetails: Meet & greet (name board): +5,000 FCFA · Night (10pm–6am) and public holidays: +25% · Corporate account available
aeroport.metaDesc: Airport transfer Léon-Mba with real-time flight tracking. Meet & greet, fixed price, 24/7. from 15,000 FCFA.

evenementiel.name: Event Transport
evenementiel.cardTagline: Your guests arrive together. That's your image.
evenementiel.h1: Your guests arrive together, on time.
evenementiel.p1: Wedding, conference, corporate dinner, ceremony: how your guests are transported says something about you.
evenementiel.p2: We manage all transport logistics: mapping departure points, coordinating drivers, keeping to schedule. You focus on your event.
evenementiel.step1: Contact us with the date, venue, number of guests and departure areas.
evenementiel.step2: We submit a customized transport package with a deposit.
evenementiel.step3: On the day, our vehicles are in place 30 minutes before the scheduled time.
evenementiel.pricing: 50,000 – 150,000 FCFA depending on volume and duration
evenementiel.pricingDetails: Package + deposit on signing · Free cancellation up to 72 hours before
evenementiel.metaDesc: Transport for weddings, conferences and events in Libreville. Organized convoys, punctuality guaranteed. Quote within 24h.

medical.name: Medical Transport
medical.cardTagline: A medical appointment is not to be missed.
medical.h1: A medical appointment is not to be missed.
medical.p1: For a patient with reduced mobility, an elderly person or a post-operative appointment, transport is not an option — it's a necessity.
medical.p2: Discreet, punctual, door-to-door. The vehicle picks you up at the agreed time.
medical.step1: Book the day before or on the morning via WhatsApp with the time, address and destination.
medical.step2: Driver confirmation sent. Pick-up at your home.
medical.step3: Return trip possible if you confirm the end of your appointment by message.
medical.pricingDetails: Monthly subscription available for regular care · Clinic partnerships: negotiated volume rates
medical.metaDesc: Door-to-door medical transport in Libreville. Trained drivers, discretion assured. from 8,000 FCFA.

livraison-express.cardTagline: Your parcel leaves now. Arrives within the hour.
livraison-express.p1: Urgent documents, professional packages, customer orders to deliver today. MoovAfrik collects and delivers within Libreville in under one hour.

about.p1: MoovAfrik is the mobility and delivery platform of Gabon Connect Technology, a Gabonese company based in Libreville. We are not an app. We are an operator — with vehicles, drivers and real accountability for every confirmed booking.
about.p2: Our belief is simple: reliable transport is not a luxury reserved for major cities. In Libreville, families deserve to know where their children are. Companies deserve shuttles that respect schedules. Business travellers deserve a proper airport transfer.
about.p3: MoovAfrik launched in 2026 with 4 owned vehicles and a network of approved partner drivers. We are starting in Libreville, with the ambition to expand our model across the CEMAC sub-region.
